mapper.sql: FROM restaurants r JOIN restaurant_categories c ON c.code = r.category_code LEFT JOIN restaurant_review_statistics s ON s.restaurant_id = r.id

CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.participant_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'none' WHEN s.overall_score_sum >= 8.6 * s.participant_count THEN 'bucket' WHEN s.overall_score_sum >= 7.4 * s.participant_count THEN 'super' WHEN s.overall_score_sum >= 6.2 * s.participant_count THEN 'large' WHEN s.overall_score_sum >= 5.0 * s.participant_count THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END

CASE WHEN r.needs_location = 0 AND r.latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND r.longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND r.coordinate_system = 'GCJ02' THEN 6371000 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0, POWER(SIN(RADIANS(r.latitude - 30.7544) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(30.7544)) * COS(RADIANS(r.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(r.longitude - 103.9312) / 2), 2))))) ELSE NULL END

r.id, r.name, r.category_code, c.name AS category_name, r.price_per_person, r.price_kind, r.address, r.latitude, r.longitude, r.coordinate_system, r.needs_location, r.business_status, r.source_type, r.created_at, r.updated_at, COALESCE(s.review_count, 0) AS review_count, COALESCE(s.participant_count, 0) AS participant_count,
CAST(s.overall_score_sum AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0) AS score, CAST(s.recommend_count AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0) AS recommend_rate, CAST(s.taste_sum AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0) AS taste, CAST(s.value_sum AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0) AS value, CAST(s.service_sum AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0) AS service, CAST(s.ambience_sum AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0) AS ambience, AS tier, () / 1000 AS distance_km
mapper.select: SELECT code, name, sort_order, enabled FROM restaurant_categories ORDER BY sort_order, code

SELECT
WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT
ORDER BY
r.price_per_person IS NULL, r.price_per_person, distance_km IS NULL, distance_km, score IS NULL, score DESC, taste IS NULL, taste DESC, value IS NULL, value DESC, service IS NULL, service DESC, ambience IS NULL, ambience DESC, review_count DESC,
r.name, r.id LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT t.restaurant_id, t.tag, t.position FROM restaurant_tags t JOIN restaurants r ON r.id = t.restaurant_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.restaurant_id IN #{id} ORDER BY t.restaurant_id, t.position
